activites: Student union (Asso MIAGE Bordeaux): President (1 year) then Vice President (1 year); College Council (Peixotto & Bordes campuses): Student elected representative (1 year 9 months).
description:
The MIAGE master's degree (Computer Methods Applied to Business Management) trains business executives who are experts in information systems engineering and management.
This five-year program combines a dual skill set in digital sciences (programming, mathematical logic…) and management sciences (finance, accounting, marketing, project management…).

The third year of the bachelor's MIAGE track (Computer Methods Applied to Business Management) combines a dual skill set in digital sciences (programming, mathematical logic…) and management sciences (finance, accounting, marketing, project management…).
This three-year program is required to enter a MIAGE master's degree.
The DUT in Computer Science trains general-purpose computer scientists through solid theoretical and practical training.
The bachelor's degree in mathematics gives students solid knowledge of mathematics, covering the basics of algebra, geometry, analysis and probability.
